record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.context_brief: Twisted intertwining operators for finite orbifolds
record.original_question: Let V be a vertex operator algebra such that V satisfies the two conditions from Conjecture 5.1, namely V(0) = C1, V(n) = 0 for n < 0, the contragredient V′ is equivalent to V as a V-module, and V is C2-cofinite, and assume in addition that every grading-restricted generalized V-module is completely reducible. For a finite group G of automorphisms of V, do the twisted intertwining operators among the g-twisted V-modules for all g in G satisfy associativity, commutativity, and modular invariance?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 5.1. Assume that V is a simple vertex operator algebra satisfying the following conditions: (1) V(0) = C1, V(n) = 0 for n< 0 and the contragredient V′, as a V -module, is equivalent to V .

(2) V is C2-coﬁnite, that is, dimV/C 2(V )<∞, where C2(V ) is the subspace of V spanned by the elements of the form Resxx−2Y (u,x )v for u,v ∈ V and Y :V⊗V →V [[x,x−1]] is the vertex operator map for V .

Conjecture 6.1. LetV be a vertex operator algebra satisfying the two condi- tions in Conjecture 5.1. Assume that in addition every grading-restricted general- izedV -module is completely reducible. Let G be a ﬁnite group of automorphisms of V . Then the twisted intertwining operators among the g-twistedV -modules for all g∈G satisfy the associativity, commutativity and modular invariance properties.

artifact.category_tag: Vertex operator algebras and orbifold CFT
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made: foundational properties of twisted intertwining operators (skew-symmetry, contragredient isomorphisms, P(z)-tensor products) have been established by Huang and collaborators (arXiv:1702.05845, arXiv:2501.15003), and modular invariance for (logarithmic) intertwining operators has been proved in the untwisted case (Comm. Math. Phys. 2024 / arXiv:2305.15152). However, the full conjecture asserting associativity, commutativity, and modular invariance for twisted intertwining operators among g-twisted V-modules for all g in a finite group G under the stated hypotheses does not appear to have been fully proved in the literature available; recent works (e.g. arXiv:2510.14860) continue to address pieces of this program.

status_evidence.title: Intertwining operators among twisted modules associated to not-necessarily-commuting automorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Defines twisted intertwining operators and proves basic properties (skew-symmetry, contragredient).
status_evidence.claim: Foundational framework for twisted intertwining operators is established but associativity/commutativity/modular invariance not fully proved here.

status_evidence.title: Twisted intertwining operators and tensor products of (generalized) twisted modules
status_evidence.snippet: Gives skew-symmetry and contragredient isomorphisms and introduces P(z)-tensor product of g-twisted modules.
status_evidence.claim: Continued partial progress toward the conjecture; full associativity/commutativity/modular invariance not yet established.

status_evidence.title: Differential equations for intertwining operators among untwisted and twisted modules
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work studying differential equations needed in the twisted setting.
status_evidence.claim: Active ongoing research toward, but not full resolution of, the conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Modular Invariance of (Logarithmic) Intertwining Operators
status_evidence.snippet: Modular invariance proved for intertwining operators among grading-restricted generalized V-modules (untwisted case).
status_evidence.claim: Modular invariance is established in the untwisted case; the twisted/orbifold version remains open in full generality.
